ios.desc:
Findio is a family tracking and location-sharing application designed to provide real-time location updates and help you stay connected with your loved ones, even when they may be unable to answer your calls.

With Findio, you can:

• Track the real-time locations of your family and friends and stay informed about their whereabouts.
• Review complete historical location data for your family members.
• Personalize geo-zones to receive automatic notifications when your children arrive at or leave specific locations, such as school or home.
• Receive help alerts when a family member or a friend indicates they are in danger and need assistance.

How Findio Works:

1. Install the Findio app from the App Store.
2. Set up user profiles on both devices.

Please note: data collection and location sharing are carried out with the consent of the user. You must have access to the linked device to install the app and enable tracking features.

Use the app to monitor your loved one’s location and stay connected.

Subscription Auto-Renewal Information:

• Payment will be charged to the iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
• Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Users can manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.

Stay connected with your family at all times!

Terms of Use: https://findiogpsapp.com/terms

Privacy Policy: https://findiogpsapp.com/privacy

We hope you enjoy using the Findio app! We’re constantly working to improve the experience and welcome your feedback at support@findiogpsapp.com.

quotes.text:
These apps do definitely exist on the App Store, as well as on Google Play and every commercial app store I know of.

They obviously don't market themselves as stalkerware, but there are plenty of "parental control" apps out there that aren't meant for tracking kids (every mobile OS can already do that out of the box, after all).

One example I quickly found is this thing: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/eyezy-find-my-friends/id1575693779 At first glance this may seem inconspicuous enough, but then they sell services like these: https://www.eyezy.com/invisible-shield that will hide these apps on jailbroken devices.
quotes.story_title: LetMeSpy, a stalkerware app spying on thousands, says it was hacked
